notes.title: Me in the Office - Launch Trailer
notes.content:
[img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/32941352/ff4b72c561bcc2ac78445442d39b9fe0cf8c79d0.png[/img]
Hello everyone! 

I am happy to introduce you the launch trailer for my new game Me in the Office.  The game has been published today after a long and difficult time in development. I really enjoyed all the development process and now the game is ready against all odds. I am thankful to everyone who supports me during this time. 

https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=me-Y_dfMggI

notes.title: Me in the Office - Major Destructions
notes.content:
Greetings! 

I thank everyone for your continued support and today I want to show you a new video showing destruction system of my new comedy game Me in the Office.
https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QJd3cZ29H3s

More content coming soon!

notes.content:

Thanks everyone for your feedback!

notes.title: UPDATE v1.01
notes.content:
Based on community feedback, please welcome the first update. Full details can be found below:

[list]
    [*] "Restart" button has been added
    [*] Shadows clipping has been fixed
    [*] "Uncommon combinations" in several levels were excluded
    [*] Small gameplay improvements and bug fixes
[/list]

Also, let me show you my new relaxing game Elbub:

http://store.steampowered.com/app/757860/Elbub/
